params.name: KSTAR_LEVEL
params.why: science_rate_question.py:28; the level whose crossing defines k*

params.name: BULK_FRACTION
params.why: track0_harness.py:32; central window selected BY ROOT INDEX (bulk_idx)

params.name: k_grid
params.why: the sealed grid; reproduction is only meaningful on it

params.name: popref_transform
params.why: the analytic seed law of the class; same eps_k rule and Richardson pairing as PROD_PRIMARY so only the seed transform differs

lineage.construction: sealed SeedSequence(20260811) children 80..95, diff_step, reference_cdf v1.5.1
lineage.data: science seal gue n=4096 replicates (regenerated roots, banked here)
lineage.protocol: rtilde over bulk_idx; F3 ladder + kstar(); interp; OLS tail

kstar_fit.method: (a) production F3 ladder + kstar() MVN draws

kstar_interp.method: (b) monotone log-linear interpolation of the ensemble mean

PROD_PRIMARY.error_models: covariance (kstar_fit.err_covariance, MVN parameter draws) AND replicate bootstrap (err_bootstrap, n_boot resamples of the 16 replicates); both always reported (errormodel.py fork)
